stories.title: Microsoft shares workaround for Windows domain login issues
stories.summary: Microsoft shared a temporary fix on Wednesday for a known issue that prevents Windows 11 users from logging in with valid domain credentials after installing the September 2026 security updates.

stories.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
stories.summary: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior.

stories.title: Britain's far right keeps up pressure over small boats despite falling immigration
stories.summary: As both legal and illegal immigration figures fall, far-right groups, backed by nationalist parties, have staged protests against irregular Channel crossings in small boats – even though these crossings account for only a very small share of total migration.

stories.title: France to host two table tennis World Cups, building on Olympics momentum and Lebrun brothers
stories.summary: The French Table Tennis Federation announced on Thursday that France will host the 2027 and 2028 editions of the sport's singles World Cup, first in Montpellier and then in Paris.

stories.title: Six-time Grand Slam champion Salisbury retires
stories.summary: Former world number one doubles player and six-time Grand Slam doubles champion Joe Salisbury retires from professional tennis.

stories.title: September 17, 1994: The day Vitas Gerulaitis tragically died in his sleep from carbon monoxide poisoning
stories.summary: Every day Tennis Majors takes you back in time to celebrate a significant moment in tennis history. Today, we go back to 1994, to the day tennis great Vitas Gerulaitis died at the age of 40 from an accidental case of carbon monoxide poisoning

kev.name: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
kev.summary: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

kev.name: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
kev.summary: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.

entries.title: Someone is counter-programming launch day
entries.body: Devolver Digital has a mystery game dated 19 November. Pre-orders have been open since June: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99, no special edition.
